description: This file defines a class DefaultFontResolver_unused implementing IFontResolver, responsible for resolving font typefaces and retrieving font data based on font family names and styles, within the PdfSharp library's font resolution subsystem.

classes.name: DefaultFontResolver_unused
classes.description: A class implementing IFontResolver, providing custom logic for resolving font typefaces and font data, primarily for Segoe UI variant fonts within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Converts font family and style parameters into a FontResolverInfo object, either by specific rules for certain font names or delegating to PlatformFontResolver.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Returns the byte array representing font data for a given face name, using predefined fonts or throwing an exception for unknown faces.
